rationale: The customer is asking to move the dates on an existing booking, a standard booking-change request.
The customer wants to book an additional item matching a previous rental, a standard booking request answerable from the account record.
The customer wants the charges on their invoice explained, a standard invoice enquiry.
The customer is asking for a copy of their invoice, a standard invoice request.
The customer is asking whether a specific excavator is available for hire, a standard availability question.

The customer is disputing the size of a damage charge and asking it be waived on the strength of loyalty and their own view that the wear was minor, which is a discretionary concession rather than something a stated policy term settles outright.
The customer is asking for a better price to match a competitor's quote, a commercial negotiation rather than a policy-resolved matter.
The customer thinks the rental days on their site-cabin invoice are wrong and wants it checked, a standard invoice query.
The customer cancelled a booking and is asking for the refund policy already provides, a standard cancellation-refund request.
The customer is making a claim under the paid Damage Waiver Cover they bought, a coverage question the waiver's own terms resolve one way or the other.
The customer is asking about delivery options and cost to a specific location, a standard delivery-logistics question.
The customer wants billing to check something on their site-cabin invoice, a standard invoice query.
The customer needs new dates for a generator booking, a standard booking-change request.
The customer states that deposits are fully refundable regardless of the equipment's returned condition, which is not how deposit deductions actually work and needs the real policy term explained.
The customer is asking how to arrange collection of returned fencing, a standard collection-logistics question.
